Exceptions of the latest run, highest score first, with optional filters.

``view`` picks an inbox tab (A25): ``attention`` is the inbox's default view; ``all``
(the default here, for the other pages) returns every finding.

Old-rule totals and per-account netting. ``materiality`` overrides the rule for a
what-if view (the slider); it does not change the saved rules.

DecisionEntry.title: DecisionEntry
DecisionEntry.description: Audit trail entry for a decision on an exception.

DecisionUpdate.description: Body of PATCH /api/exceptions/{id}. A reason is required for any decided status.

EvidenceLine.title: EvidenceLine

ExceptionDetail.title: ExceptionDetail

ExceptionRecord.title: ExceptionRecord
ExceptionRecord.description: One finding. Every engine emits this shape (brief section 7).

ExposureGroup.title: ExposureGroup
ExposureGroup.description: Payroll netting per ERP, entity and account (brief section 8).

ExposureResponse.title: ExposureResponse
ExposureResponse.description: GET /api/exposure/payroll: the old report next to the real exposure.

ExtractSource.title: ExtractSource
ExtractSource.description: ADDITION (#24, A38): one workbook a run read, with where it came from.

Health.title: Health
Health.description:
ADDITION (review of 22 Nov 2026, fix 3, docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md A45): GET /api/health.

``assistant``: "on" when Ollama answers and the configured model is pulled; "offline" when
it is enabled but Ollama does not answer or lacks the model; "off" when disabled in the
settings. Without the assistant, notes use the labelled standard wording (A29).

NormalSide.title: NormalSide
NormalSide.description:
ADDITION (review of 22 Nov 2026, docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md A43): the side an account's balance
normally sits on, for every account of one ERP whose number starts with ``account_prefix``.
The longest matching prefix wins; an account no entry matches has an unknown side.

batch_text_pattern.title: Batch Text Pattern
batch_text_pattern.description: Regex on the line Text; group 'period' holds the period label

PaymentProfile.title: PaymentProfile
PaymentProfile.description: How one account accrues and pays (brief section 8, Pulse table).

RuleChange.title: RuleChange
RuleChange.description: One entry of the append-only rules change log.

Rules.title: Rules
Rules.description: Controller-set parameters. Brief fields first; every engine threshold lives here.

RulesUpdate.title: RulesUpdate
RulesUpdate.description: Body of PUT /api/rules: the full new rules plus who and why.

Run.title: Run
Run.description: One pipeline run over one snapshot.

TimelinePoint.title: TimelinePoint
TimelinePoint.description: Gap chart point: month-end balance, expected balance and gap (brief section 8).

TypoCheck.title: TypoCheck
TypoCheck.description:
ADDITION (#30, A6): the assistant's reading of a spelling prompt.

Advisory only: it never changes the record's id, score, status, class or exposure, and a
"not_a_typo" verdict never hides the prompt. The controller can allow-list the word.
